# SNGL spells a two-word event in camelCase and the DOM spells it lowercase.
# html's wildcard event pattern was lowercase-only, so every camelCase handler
# was dropped with no diagnostic -- including @scrollEnd and @longPress, both
# declared in the standard library.

sngl generate --lang none --platform html --out out app.sngl
grep 'addEventListener\("scrollend"' out/index.html
grep 'addEventListener\("longpress"' out/index.html
grep 'addEventListener\("click"' out/index.html

# The camelCase spelling must not reach the DOM: it is not an event type.
! grep 'addEventListener\("scrollEnd"' out/index.html
! grep 'addEventListener\("longPress"' out/index.html

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl://std"

component main {
    var n = 0
    scroll(@scrollEnd { n = n + 1 }) {
        text(value=string(n))
    }
    button(text="hit", @longPress { n = 0 }, @click { n = n + 1 })
}
